arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Edlin argued the scope test conflicts with the statute's plain language.
Mr. Schlick argued the text covers any person employed by the enterprise.
Mr. Fleming argued applying the statute to ordinary business is absurd.
